pipeline.title: 9 pharma leaders sound ‘alarm bells’ on biotech’s decline in Europe
pipeline.summary: Frustrated by a slump that’s seen Europe lose ground to the U.S. and China, several top drugmakers are calling for speedier clinical trials, intellectual property protections and “fiscal flexibility.”

pipeline.title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop
pipeline.summary: Immunovant has stopped development of IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus after failing a midphase test, closing off one path to market for the anti-FcRn antibody.

pipeline.title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
pipeline.summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

pipeline.title: Amgen reports a Phase 3 win with Sjögren’s drug candidate
pipeline.summary: Dazodalibep, acquired in Amgen’s big buyout of Horizon Therapeutics, succeeded in the first of two late-stage trials against the tough-to-treat autoimmune disorder.

pipeline.title: Celldex monoclonal antibody rebounds with pair of phase 3 wins for chronic skin condition
pipeline.summary: Celldex touted a double phase 3 trial win in patients with treatment-refractory chronic spontaneous urticaria.

pipeline.title: Amgen’s Horizon-acquired fusion protein eases Sjögren's severity in ph. 3 win
pipeline.summary: An investigational drug for the autoimmune condition Sjögren's disease has scored a phase 3 win for Amgen, marking a positive sign for the Horizon Therapeutics-acquired pipeline that has so far struggled to gain traction.

pipeline.title: Vertex’s midstage data amplify kidney disease market opportunity
pipeline.summary: Vertex has reported positive phase 2b data for its kidney disease prospect inaxaplin, boosting its efforts to expand beyond the population targeted in a pivotal trial.

pipeline.title: Otsuka heads to FDA as Ionis-partnered ALS drug hits primary phase 3 endpoint
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 study of Otsuka and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ amyotrophic lateral sclerosis drug candidate has hit its primary endpoint, positioning the partners to talk to regulators about expedited approvals.

pipeline.title: Cordis’ sirolimus drug-coated balloon earns FDA approval as a breakthrough device
pipeline.summary: The FDA gave the green light to a first and only sirolimus drug-eluting balloon designed by Cordis to treat coronary in-stent restenosis.

pipeline.title: Roche’s GLP-1/GIP drug hits in phase 2 diabetes trial, fueling best-in-disease hopes
pipeline.summary: A phase 2 trial of Roche’s dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist has hit its primary endpoints, painting the drug candidate as a potential treatment for people with type 2 diabetes and overweight or obesity.

pipeline.title: J&J firms up Caplyta's 1st phase 3 win in bipolar-associated manic episodes
pipeline.summary: As Johnson & Johnson’s $14.6 billion bet on Intra-Cellular Therapies continues to pay off with blockbuster sales of Caplyta, the atypical antipsychotic has passed a phase 3 test that puts it one step closer to a broader psychiatric label.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly escalates oral SERD battle with FDA approval for Inluriyo, Verzenio combo
pipeline.summary: With longer progression-free survival, Jake Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology, told Fierce he expects most patients to choose the combination over oral SERD monotherapy.

pipeline.title: Changing expectations: How GRAM is strengthening CDMO partnerships
pipeline.summary: How proactive risk management, transparency and flexible communication can turn a CDMO relationship into a true strategic partnership.

pipeline.title: Clinical trials reach a new automation inflection point
pipeline.summary: As trial complexity grows, agentic AI is emerging as a new model for connecting workflows and accelerating execution.

pipeline.title: Enveda, an AI drugmaker, banks $311M in venture funding
pipeline.summary: Enveda, which is using AI tools to mine plants and microbes for drug prospects, has three candidates in human testing for immune diseases and obesity.

pipeline.title: Roche, Ionis RNA drug scores in kidney disease study
pipeline.summary: The results position Roche to bring a new kind of medicine to market for IgA nephropathy, a disease that’s drawn considerable attention of late from drugmakers.

pipeline.title: Novo CEO sees advantages in souping up NYSE listing: report
pipeline.summary: The Ozempic and Wegovy maker's CEO said he's open to a direct listing of Novo's shares on the New York Stock Exchange, but no such transition is currently underway.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly CEO touts 70% share as Medicare GLP-1 program reaches 700K seniors
pipeline.summary: Sign-ups for Medicare’s GLP-1 coverage plan keep expanding, and Eli Lilly is dominating the market with 70% share, the company’s CEO David Ricks said.

pipeline.title: Cellares pens 2nd automation test with Asia-based cell therapy partner in 2 weeks
pipeline.summary: Despite hitting a speed bump over the summer, automated cell therapy manufacturing specialist Cellares has continued to sign new partners at a steady pace, now inking a second agreement with an Asia-based organization in just over a week.

pipeline.title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
pipeline.summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

pipeline.title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
pipeline.summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

pipeline.title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has dived deeper into its collaboration with Variant Bio by expanding the collaboration to cover cardiovascular disease to the tune of $250 million.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca recommits to youth health to dial funding past $100M
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has re-upped its UNICEF-partnered Young Health Programme, committing to a new five-year phase that will move total investment in the initiative above $100 million.

pipeline.title: 'The growth driver of our organization'; Genentech CMO Zoë Lazarre on experimental marketing, AI and the ‘last mile gap’
pipeline.summary: Genentech's chief marketing officer Zoë Lazarre, Ph.D., likens AI to a “armor, or a digital backpack” that her teams can use for better, faster insights, she said during an interview at Fierce Pharma Week.

pipeline.title: Bristol Myers cuts another 265 jobs tied to New Jersey headquarters
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb plans to lay off another 265 employees tied to its corporate headquarters in New Jersey, bringing the number of total job reductions the company has announced this year in the Garden State to more than 700.

pipeline.title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
pipeline.summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

pipeline.title: Novartis secures new radioligand in $900M deal as competition strengthens
pipeline.summary: As an imposing new competitor begins to take shape, radiopharma leader Novartis has beefed up its pipeline by licensing a preclinical radioligand therapy from a specialist Chinese biotech.

pipeline.title: Viking shares surge on updated obesity drug data
pipeline.summary: Trial participants mostly kept their weight down after switching from a weekly shot to less frequent dosing — findings that could strengthen Viking’s “competitive positioning,” one analyst wrote.

pipeline.title: Celldex sinks as safety concerns cloud immune drug results
pipeline.summary: Though barzolvolimab displayed what one analyst described as the best efficacy results to date against chronic skin hives, treatment was also associated with two life-threatening anaphylaxis cases.

pipeline.title: 'Europe does not value what you do': 9 pharmas make urgent call for bloc to beef up innovation muscle
pipeline.summary: As China and the U.S. presently duke it out over biopharma innovation supremacy, a clutch of Europe’s biggest drugmakers are calling on the bloc to not lose sight of its R&D roots.

pipeline.title: An orexin drug’s ‘proof-of-concept’ in ADHD; Cue’s ‘unwarranted’ share slide
pipeline.summary: Alkermes’ results heightened anticipation for a coming readout in 2027. Elsewhere, AbbVie leaned into AI drug discovery and the FDA expanded use of Eli Lilly’s breast cancer pill.

pipeline.title: Lexeo takes up the Mantle in $8M acquisition for Friedreich ataxia assets
pipeline.summary: Lexeo Therapeutics has agreed to acquire Mantle Therapeutics via an upfront payment of $8.3 million, aiming to expand its Friedreich ataxia (FA) portfolio while locking in three strategic collaborations to support its lead asset.

pipeline.title: Travere CEO Eric Dube to step down after transforming the rare disease biotech
pipeline.summary: Eric Dube, Ph.D., the CEO who rebranded Travere Therapeutics and oversaw the launch of its rare kidney disease drug Filspari, will step down to “focus on his health and family.” Bradley Campbell, formerly CEO of Amicus Therapeutics, will take the reins.

pipeline.title: Siemens Healthineers and Novo team up on fatty liver disease awareness, testing
pipeline.summary: Siemens Healthineers is joining forces with Novo to help boost awareness and diagnosis of fatty liver disease.

pipeline.title: Par Health recalls IV sedative in US, flagging presence of cellulose, stopper material
pipeline.summary: Par Health issued a voluntary recall of two lots of the IV sedative dexmedetomidine HCl in 0.9% sodium chloride injection that may be contaminated with cellulose or stopper material.

pipeline.title: A hidden tradeoff in Trump’s drug pricing deals
pipeline.summary: The government has announced “most-favored-nation” pricing agreements with 26 pharma companies. But the deals could stymie other plans to lower the country’s spending on prescription drugs.

pipeline.title: Anaconda Biomed snares $56M in funding for endovascular tech
pipeline.summary: Medtech startup Anaconda Biomed has hauled in $53 million to help finish off work on a pivotal trial for its endovascular project.

pipeline.title: Iambic maintains momentum from string of Big Pharma partnerships by aiming for IPO
pipeline.summary: Iambic Therapeutics is maintaining the momentum generated by its recent mega round and Big Pharma partnerships by gearing up to go public.

pipeline.title: Organon-commissioned survey finds 1 in 3 UK women feel their migraine pain not taken seriously
pipeline.summary: One in three women in the U.K. feel their migraine pain “is taken less seriously by others because of their gender.”

pipeline.title: Boehringer, Envisagenics sign $1B multi-target oncology collaboration
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim and AI drug discovery company Envisagenics have agreed to a potential $1 billion multi-year pact that will task Boehringer with validating tumor-specific targets.

pipeline.title: Beacon eye gene therapy hits mark in late-stage study
pipeline.summary: Beacon claimed the findings represent the first time a treatment for X-linked retinitis pigmentosa, a rare and potentially blinding condition, met its main goal in a pivotal trial.

pipeline.title: Trump calls for some childhood vaccines be split into smaller doses
pipeline.summary: The president announced plans to split some childhood immunizations in the U.S. into five separate shots, given as “20% doses” every six months. The decision has garnered significant backlash from the medical community.

pipeline.title: Novo talks up drug launches in effort to win back investors
pipeline.summary: At a “capital markets day” in London, executives outlined a roadmap to better compete with key rival Eli Lilly and soon bring forth several multibillion-dollar products.

pipeline.title: New MFN deal details reignite concerns that Trump's pricing policy favors pharma
pipeline.summary: Amid lawmaker and advocacy group efforts to parse the White House’s “most favored nation” drug pricing deals with drugmakers, newly revealed—yet heavily redacted—information is reigniting concerns about just who exactly the Trump administration policy benefits.

pipeline.title: IntraBio's Aqneursa scores expansion, now the first treatment for rare ataxia
pipeline.summary: IntraBio's streak of success in the rare neurological category continues, as the drugmaker racks up a second indication for Aqneursa, now the first treatment in the world indicated for a rare ataxia.

pipeline.title: White House plans to put NIH grants under political control: reports
pipeline.summary: President Donald Trump is attempting to seize further control of funding decisions made by the National Institutes of Health. According to multiple reports, senior officials met in the Oval Office on Friday to discuss plans for an executive order that would create an external pan

pipeline.title: Novo struggles to appease restive investors with consumer plans, blockbuster ambitions
pipeline.summary: With reports leaking out of investor discontent, CEO Mike Doustdar opened Novo's Capital Markets Day by acknowledging that the company’s leadership “have to convince” the audience that “there is a bright future for Novo.”

pipeline.title: Bayer offloads cancer drug Stivarga to Grünenthal for up to $431M as new competition looms
pipeline.summary: Bayer has decided to offload its aging cancer drug Stivarga to German compatriot Grünenthal as a potential new competitor from Exelixis nears an FDA decision.

pipeline.title: China targets 25% share of global first-in-class drugs in new 5-year plan
pipeline.summary: China is aiming to account for at least 25% of first-in-class drugs as part of a five-year push to cement its emerging status as a hotbed for innovative R&D.

pipeline.title: Analysts ‘extremely bullish’ as Telix beams into Novartis’ territory with $1.6B ITM acquisition
pipeline.summary: Telix has struck a deal to buy ITM Isotope Technologies Munich for $1.65 billion upfront, securing an R&D pipeline led by a rival to Novartis’ Lutathera and a radiopharmaceutical supply network.

pipeline.title: Journalist and menopause advocate Tamsen Fadal shines a light on overlooked women’s health topics
pipeline.summary: Journalist-turned-menopause advocate Tamsen Fadal is using her storytelling skills to bring overlooked menopause conversations into the mainstream.

pipeline.title: With pioneering ADHD data, Alkermes eyes orexin agonist as potential ‘company changer’
pipeline.summary: Following Takeda’s historic approval of the first orexin agonist with its narcolepsy treatment Orzeyful, Alkermes has followed up with pioneering data that looks to take the hyped drug class out of sleep disorders and into broader patient populations.

pipeline.title: Europe's CHMP endorses slew of new medicines, including new offerings from Novo and AZ
pipeline.summary: The CHMP recommendation for Novo's next gen hemophilia A treatment was one of several noteworthy endorsements made by the EU agency this week.

pipeline.title: How Learning Systems Move Pharma Marketing Beyond the Box Score
pipeline.summary: It’s time for pharma marketers to up their ask of AI—not just making better decisions, but building smarter systems that learn from every outcome.

pipeline.title: Beyond clinical endpoints: Rethinking ALS drug development through disease biology
pipeline.summary: After decades of hard-won progress, ALS drug development is entering a new era, building on established efficacy measures like survival and ALSFRS-R with biology-driven science that captures the full heterogeneity of the disease.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: FDA updates for Merck's Winrevair, Nuvation's Ibtrozi lead regulatory deluge
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Holiday takes toll on prescriptions
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: BMS slashes 265 HQ roles; Novo reveals 4k more employees were laid off
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: All 50 states apply to participate in new Medicaid drug pricing model, White House says
pipeline.summary: The Trump administration is rolling out a new model that aims to bring most-favored nation pricing to the Medicaid space.
